The structural and technical analysis consumed the better part of three weeks before we could make the commitment to produce this unique aircraft," says Roth.

Despite many quirky refurbishing requests, Roth says a fair percentage of his clients avoid using their aircraft to make a statement: "They will come to me saying 'Eric, I want it to be luxuriously comfortable, very functional but extremely understated'." Nearly 75 per cent of the firm's chents are US-based, but it is
now receiving more requests from private-jet owners in Asia. The company has worked with chents in Shanghai, Tokyo and Mumbai, and is in discussions with new customers in Africa.
